children: Japanese government bond yields are higher as concerns about elevated energy prices and the Bank of Japan's further rate increases offset haven demand stemming from a selloff in artificial-intelligence-related stocks. While holding the rate steady, the Japanese central bank on Friday declared victory in its decadeslong battle against deflation, paving the way for more interest-rate increases. Investors are focusing on developments in the Middle East and crude oil prices. The 10-year JGB yield is half a basis point higher at 2.775%. (kosaku.narioka@wsj.com; @kosakunarioka)
